names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 23 декабря ст. ст., «Макарий (Миронов), иеромонах, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The day's own line declines the forename and gives the name without the surname; the surname it does print at the end of the line is the third man's.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 23 декабря ст. ст. closes with: «Сщмч. Василия пресвитера и прмч. Макария и Ионы Смирнова (1938).»

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Василия пресвитера и прмч. Макария и Ионы Смирнова (1938).»

attestations.note: One line for three men and this folder is the second of them. The two ranks the calendar gives him differ: the day's line governs his name with «прмч.», a venerable-martyr, while name page 9223 closes his fuller form with «сщмч.», a hieromartyr, and gives his grade as hieromonk. Both readings are the calendar's own and neither is resolved here; the types follow the day line. The name page lists a second day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia; it is recorded here and the folder does not render on it. Neither page carries a life.
